answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Signed chiropractic visit record with chiropractic council attestation. It demands visits the council recorded across years of adjustments, and the ocean is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that visits the council recorded across years of adjustments — so privacy survives, and the falcon is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The tundra is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
